raw.pairedTextScope: All paired text remains indexed in the raw manifest; eleven specifically inspected measurements are bound under geometryFacts.

observations: At667x375 and852x393 default text, score and pause remain pinned in the left instrument area. Five ordered forecast facts, full-column recovery and near-column facts remain readable in the sampled top/bottom facts states. The complete ceiling strip and actual stars occupy the distinct right board area; no text shrink or score digit split is visible.

At both short AX5 proposals, the complete score and150,000 target keep their native two-line size. The actual board remains painted with at least one full row of seven current stars. Programmatically revealed ceiling badges are complete and distinct from the left instrument area. Top/bottom facts endpoints show the large Next label and near-column list; they do not visually witness every intermediate forecast/full-column sentence.

At375 portrait large/xxxLarge/AX5 the earned score/target, forecast instruments and full/near status preserve readable hierarchy. Revealed ceiling markers remain separate from the header. Stars continue below these instruments with the approved continuous scenery treatment.

The busy-state before/busy/after set retains score, forecast values and geometry while Help becomes visibly muted during the held presenter and returns after. The default-before frame is an early starless capture and is excluded as settled-board proof; default busy/after and all three AX5 frames contain actual stars.

In375 and synthetic1024 maximum-text receipt states, the15,000 exact score, ordered forecast and receipt remain distinct. Source-local constellation lines do not cover essential score or forecast ink. The compact frame shows+5,000 while the larger proposal shows+15,000; these are different captured presentation moments, not an equality or motion claim.

OpenSky five-star, empty-live, suspended, resumed and next-shower samples retain painted scenery and complete native instruments. The empty sample is intentionally empty after a committed clear; no flat gray scene-sized rectangle is visible.

The three Sunny hosted samples retain native large text on the existing reader material. The programmatic-end image shows the last instruction line and Close. This establishes static extent/ownership visibility only, not a native pan or VoiceOver action.
